_policy: Default-deny. Only tools listed in `allowlist` are registered. RED denylist is enforced at catalog load time (see _hackingtool_deny_pattern in tool_catalog.py).
_review_notes: Audit identified ~45 GREEN + ~85 YELLOW tools. This catalog lands 25 GREEN + 15 YELLOW. YELLOW tools are tier-tagged but only executable through check_yellow_runtime() in yellow_runtime_gate.py -- see docs/HACKINGTOOL_INTEGRATION.md section 'Applied decisions 2026-04-23'.

_applied_decisions_2026_04_23.q1_yellow_tier: Pro+ only (matches Burp Community/Pro industry split)
_applied_decisions_2026_04_23.q2_ad_tools: YELLOW + FOUNDER tier + per-project authorized_scope AD domain (BloodHound, Impacket, Responder, NetExec, Certipy, Kerbrute)
_applied_decisions_2026_04_23.q3_c2_frameworks: Catalog-only, never run from Daena (Sliver, Havoc, Mythic). Not added to JSON allowlist yet.
_applied_decisions_2026_04_23.q4_wireless: YELLOW (requires physical radio access). Only passive tools (hcxtools) considered. Active rogue-AP / deauth tools stay RED.
_applied_decisions_2026_04_23.q5_socialmedia: Split -- Sherlock/SocialScan/maigret = GREEN (public OSINT). Facebook-bruteforce, social-media-bruteforce = RED.
_applied_decisions_2026_04_23.q6_auto_install: One-click confirm. User sees which binary is pulled before each install.
_applied_decisions_2026_04_23.q7_stale_upstream_flag: Yes. Tools whose upstream repo has no commit in > 18 months surface a UI warning (implemented as a `stale_after_days: 540` field per-entry in future refresh script).

red_denylist_reasons.phishing: Credential-stealing kits with near-zero legitimate use outside isolated red-team labs. Accessorial liability exposure for MAS-AI.
red_denylist_reasons.ddos: Stress/flood weapons with no defensive equivalent. Accept raw target URLs with no authorization check.
red_denylist_reasons.payload: AV-evading malware generators (RATs, droppers, silent webcam capture, Android payloads).
red_denylist_reasons.keylogger: Silent keystroke exfiltration. No consented-use path that Daena's governance permits.
red_denylist_reasons.wifi-active: Rogue AP / evil-twin / deauth = active denial-of-service against wireless networks and their users.
red_denylist_reasons.android-abuse: Lockscreen phishing, SMS spam, malicious APKs targeting third-party handsets.
red_denylist_reasons.idn-homograph: Punycode-lookalike URL generator used exclusively for phishing.
red_denylist_reasons.social-bruteforce: Social-network credential brute-forcers. ToS violation + account takeover tool.
red_denylist_reasons.doxxing: Geolocation + social-engineering tools targeting specific individuals without consent.
